changeRequests.fteHint: Decimal string, up to 4 fraction digits. Sent exactly as typed.
changeRequests.reasonRequired: Record why the change is proposed.
changeRequests.reasonSubmitNote: The reason is required to submit or withdraw. It is stamped on the approval run, not stored on the draft.
changeRequests.submitDescription: Submitting opens the governed approval run. The reason is stamped on the run.
changeRequests.withdrawDescription: Withdrawing a pending request also cancels its approval run. The reason is recorded as audit evidence.
